title: Everybody In Savoy — basketball district title
text: EVERYBODY IN SAVOY went to Bonham to see the boys basketball team win the district 45-B title for the first time in history, said Postmaster Claud Strickland. And Strickland, a boys fan of 25 years standing, says that the fans will go to Kilgore if Savoy can get past Quitman. "There will be some present anyway, but not the mob that will show if they win," he said.
